summary: Tested BDE-style Tasks Module features. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified - stats cards, quick filter tabs, advanced filters, table view, timer functionality (start/pause/resume/finish), recurrence support (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/weekdays/custom), time tracking display, and task detail modal.
seed_data_creation: SEO department has project 'Acme Corp SEO Campaign' with 4 tasks including one with recurrence='weekdays' (Weekly SEO Report) and time_tracking with 3 seconds logged
context_for_next_testing_agent: BDE-style Tasks Module fully tested. All features working: Stats cards (Total/Pending/In Progress/Completed), Quick filter tabs (All/My Tasks/Pending/In Progress/Completed), Advanced filters (Date with All Time/Today/Single/Range, Assigned To, Assigned By, Type, Status), Reset Filters button, Table view with all columns (TASK/STATUS/CREATED-ASSIGNED/DUE DATE/LINK/TIME/TIMER/ACTIONS), Timer with Start/Resume/Pause/Finish states, Recurrence support (none/daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/weekdays/custom with repeat_every/repeat_unit/repeat_on_days), Time tracking display, Task detail modal with all info.

stats_cards.details: Shows Total Tasks (4), Pending (1), In Progress (2), Completed (1) with correct counts

quick_filter_tabs.details: All tabs work: All, My Tasks, Pending, In Progress, Completed - filters tasks correctly

advanced_filters_panel.details: Date filter (All Time/Today/Single Date/Date Range), Assigned To (All/Myself/users), Assigned By, Type (All Types/General/Meeting/Follow Up/Proposal/Call), Status (All Status/Pending/In Progress/Completed/On Hold)

reset_filters_button.details: Clears all filters and resets to default values

table_view_columns.details: All columns present: TASK, STATUS, CREATED/ASSIGNED, DUE DATE, LINK, TIME, TIMER, ACTIONS

timer_start.details: Start button starts timer, shows 'Timer started' toast, changes to Resume/Finish buttons

timer_pause.details: Pause functionality works, accumulates time correctly

timer_resume.details: Resume button continues timer from paused state

timer_finish.details: Finish button completes time tracking, shows 'Done' badge, displays total time

recurrence_field.details: Create Task modal has Recurrence dropdown with options: None (One-time), Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, Weekdays (Mon-Fri), Custom

custom_recurrence.details: Custom recurrence shows: Repeat Every (number), Unit (Week(s)), Repeat On (day checkboxes Sun-Sat)

recurrence_indicator.details: Due Date column shows recurrence indicator e.g., 'Every Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri' for weekdays tasks

time_tracking_display.details: TIME column shows accumulated time (e.g., '2s', '3s'), running indicator shows 'Running...' text

task_detail_modal.details: Shows all task info: name, description, priority, status, type, due date, time spent, created by, assigned to, recurrence

create_edit_task_modal.details: Has all BDE-style fields: Task Name, Description, Priority, Type, Assign To, Due Date, Due Time, Recurrence, Status, Work Link
